title: Share regression fixtures across related repairs
summary: Map issues to shared regression coverage where they exercise the same mechanism. Start with receipt provenance, where adopter and learning receipts need to identify the exact inputs and implementation used.

origin.source: 2026-11-19 · Published repair plan's related checkpoints and the README HQ discussion about why issues appear connected.

benefits: Makes shared assumptions visible and lets each checkpoint run the smallest relevant regression fixture.
risks: Grouping symptoms can conceal distinct causes. A shared fixture needs an assertion and recorded result for each issue it covers.

evidence.claim: The plan groups scope and provenance issues including #78, #79, and #103 while retaining per-issue acceptance.
